fields.description: Radio data rate and modulation setting. The radio supports frequency-shift keying (FSK) modulation.

values.description: Long range 125 kbps TX, 125 kbps and 500 kbps RX

values.name: Ble_LR500Kbit
values.description: Long range 500 kbps TX, 125 kbps and 500 kbps RX

values.name: RxIdle
values.description: RADIO is in the RXIDLE state

values.name: Rx
values.description: RADIO is in the RX state

values.name: RxDisable
values.description: RADIO is in the RXDISABLE state

values.name: TxRu
values.description: RADIO is in the TXRU state

values.name: TxIdle
values.description: RADIO is in the TXIDLE state

values.name: Tx

fields.name: EDCNT
fields.description: IEEE 802.15.4 energy detect loop count

fields.name: EDPERIOD
fields.description: IEEE 802.15.4 energy detect period, 4us resolution, no averaging except the IEEE 802.15.4 ED range 128us (32)

fields.name: EDLVL
fields.description: IEEE 802.15.4 energy detect level

fields.name: CCAMODE
fields.description: CCA mode of operation

values.name: CarrierAndEdMode
values.description: Energy above threshold AND carrier seen

values.name: CarrierOrEdMode
values.description: Energy above threshold OR carrier seen

values.name: EdModeTest1
values.description: Energy above threshold test mode that will abort when first ED measurement over threshold is seen. No averaging.

fields.name: CCAEDTHRES
fields.description: CCA energy busy threshold. Used in all the CCA modes except CarrierMode.

fields.name: CCACORRTHRES
fields.description: CCA correlator busy threshold. Only relevant to CarrierMode, CarrierAndEdMode, and CarrierOrEdMode.

fields.name: CCACORRCNT
fields.description: Limit for occurances above CCACORRTHRES. When not equal to zero the corrolator based signal detect is enabled.

fields.name: DATAWHITEIV
fields.description: Data whitening initial value. Bit 6 is hardwired to '1', writing '0' to it has no effect, and it will always be read back and used by the device as '1'.

fields.name: RU
fields.description: Ramp-up time

fields.name: FREQUENCY
fields.description: Radio channel frequency. Frequency = 2400 + FREQUENCY (MHz).

fields.name: MAP
fields.description: Channel map selection. 0: Channel map between 2400 MHZ to 2500 MHz, Frequency = 2400 + FREQUENCY (MHz). 1: Channel map between 2360 MHZ to 2460 MHz, Frequency = 2360 + FREQUENCY (MHz).

fields.name: TXPOWER
fields.description: RADIO output power

fields.name: TIFS
fields.description: Interframe spacing in us. Interframe space is the time interval between two consecutive packets. It is defined as the time, in microseconds, from the end of the last bit of the previous packet to the start of the first bit of the subsequent packet.

fields.name: RSSISAMPLE
fields.description: RSSI sample result. The value of this register is read as a positive value while the actual received signal strength is a negative value. Actual received signal strength is therefore as follows: received signal strength = -A dBm.

fields.name: SCALERMODE
fields.description: Mode for narrow scaling output.

registers.name: DFEMODE
registers.description: Whether to use Angle-of-Arrival (AOA) or Angle-of-Departure (AOD)

fields.name: DFEOPMODE
fields.description: Direction finding operation mode

values.name: AoD
values.description: Direction finding mode set to AoD

values.name: AoA
values.description: Direction finding mode set to AoA

fields.name: SWITCHINGSTATE
fields.description: Internal state of switching state machine

fields.name: SAMPLINGSTATE
fields.description: Internal state of sampling state machine

fields.name: NUMBEROF8US
fields.description: Length of the AoA/AoD procedure in number of 8 us units

fields.name: DFEINEXTENSION
fields.description: Add CTE extension and do antenna switching/sampling in this extension

values.name: CRC
values.description: AoA/AoD procedure triggered at end of CRC

values.name: Payload
values.description: Antenna switching/sampling is done in the packet payload

fields.name: TSWITCHSPACING
fields.description: Interval between every time the antenna is changed in the SWITCHING state

fields.name: TSAMPLESPACINGREF
fields.description: Interval between samples in the REFERENCE period

fields.name: SAMPLETYPE
fields.description: Whether to sample I/Q or magnitude/phase

values.name: IQ
values.description: Complex samples in I and Q

values.name: MagPhase
values.description: Complex samples as magnitude and phase

fields.name: TSAMPLESPACING
fields.description: Interval between samples in the SWITCHING period when CTEINLINECTRLEN is 0

fields.name: REPEATPATTERN
fields.description: Repeat every antenna pattern N times.

values.name: NoRepeat
values.description: Do not repeat (1 time in total)

fields.name: AGCBACKOFFGAIN
fields.description: Gain will be lowered by the specified number of gain steps at the start of CTE

fields.name: TSWITCHOFFSET
fields.description: Signed value offset after the end of the CRC before starting switching in number of 16M cycles

fields.name: TSAMPLEOFFSET
fields.description: Signed value offset before starting sampling in number of 16M cycles relative to the beginning of the REFERENCE state - 12 us after switching start
